title: Catching Fire? Social Interactions, Beliefs, and Wildfire Risk Mitigation Behaviors
abstract: Social interactions are widely recognized as a potential influence on risk-related behaviors. We present a mediation model in which social interactions (classified as formal/informal and generic/fire-specific) are associated with beliefs about wildfire risk and mitigation options, which in turn shape wildfire mitigation behaviors. We test this model using survey data from fire-prone areas of Colorado. In several cases, our results are consistent with the mediation hypotheses for mitigation actions specifically targeting vegetative fuel reduction. Perceived wildfire probability partially mediates the relationship between several interaction types and vegetative mitigation behaviors, while perceptions of aesthetic barriers and lack of information play a mediating role in the case of fire-specific formal interactions. Our results suggest that social interactions may allow mitigation and prevention behaviors to “catch fire” within a community, and that wildfire education programs could leverage these interactions to enhance programmatic benefits.
abstract_zh: 社会互动被广泛认为会对与风险相关的行为产生潜在影响。我们提出了一个中介模型，其中社会互动（分为正式/非正式以及一般性/火灾专门性）与人们对野火风险及缓解选项的认知相关联，而这些认知进而影响野火缓解行为。我们利用科罗拉多州易发火灾地区的调查数据检验了该模型。在若干情形下，我们的结果与针对植被燃料削减这类缓解行动的中介假说相一致。感知到的野火发生概率，部分中介了若干类互动与植被缓解行为之间的关系，而对美学障碍和信息缺乏的感知，则在火灾专门性正式互动的情形中起中介作用。我们的结果表明，社会互动可能使缓解与预防行为在社区内“蔓延”开来，野火教育项目可以利用这些互动来增强项目效益。

title: Hypothetical Bias Reconsidered: Payment and Provision Uncertainties in a Threshold Provision Mechanism
Social Amplification of Wildfire Risk: The Role of Social Interactions and Information Sources
abstract: Wildfire is a persistent and growing threat across much of the western United States. Understanding how people living in fire‐prone areas perceive this threat is essential to the design of effective risk management policies. Drawing on the social amplification of risk framework, we develop a conceptual model of wildfire risk perceptions that incorporates the social processes that likely shape how individuals in fire‐prone areas come to understand this risk, highlighting the role of information sources and social interactions. We classify information sources as expert or nonexpert, and group social interactions according to two dimensions: formal versus informal, and generic versus fire‐specific. Using survey data from two Colorado counties, we empirically examine how information sources and social interactions relate to the perceived probability and perceived consequences of a wildfire. Our results suggest that social amplification processes play a role in shaping how individuals in this area perceive wildfire risk. A key finding is that both “vertical” (i.e., expert information sources and formal social interactions) and “horizontal” (i.e., nonexpert information and informal interactions) interactions are associated with perceived risk of experiencing a wildfire. We also find evidence of perceived “risk interdependency”—that is, homeowners’ perceptions of risk are higher when vegetation on neighboring properties is perceived to be dense. Incorporating social amplification processes into community‐based wildfire education programs and evaluating these programs’ effectiveness constitutes an area for future inquiry.
abstract_zh: 野火是美国西部大部分地区持续存在且日益加重的威胁。了解易发火灾地区的居民如何感知这一威胁，对于设计有效的风险管理政策至关重要。借鉴风险的社会放大框架，我们构建了一个野火风险认知的概念模型，该模型纳入了可能塑造易发火灾地区个人如何理解这一风险的社会过程，并突出了信息来源和社会互动的作用。我们将信息来源划分为专家来源与非专家来源，并依据两个维度对社会互动进行分组：正式与非正式，以及一般性与火灾专门性。利用来自科罗拉多州两个县的调查数据，我们实证考察了信息来源和社会互动如何与人们感知的野火发生概率和感知后果相关。我们的结果表明，社会放大过程在塑造该地区个人对野火风险的认知方面发挥了作用。一个关键发现是，“纵向”（即专家信息来源和正式社会互动）与“横向”（即非专家信息和非正式互动）两类互动，都与感知到的遭遇野火的风险相关联。我们还发现了感知“风险相互依赖”的证据，即当邻近房产的植被被认为茂密时，房主对风险的感知会更高。将社会放大过程纳入以社区为基础的野火教育项目，并评估这些项目的有效性，是未来值得探讨的领域。

Money, who needs it? Natural Resource Damage Assessment
abstract: A new natural resource damage assessment paradigm has been suggested that emphasizes direct analysis of compensatory restoration rather than analysis of compensating variation for damages. This article considers whether money can be avoided in damage assessment. The analysis of compensatory restoration leads to the conclusion that money should be considered when measuring preferences. Failure to consider money leaves trustees unable to judge the adequacy of compensatory restoration. The problem stems from heterogeneity over restoration scale.
abstract_zh: 一种新的自然资源损害评估范式被提出，该范式强调直接分析补偿性修复，而非分析损害的补偿性变动。本文探讨在损害评估中能否避开货币。对补偿性修复的分析得出结论：在衡量偏好时应当考虑货币。若不考虑货币，受托人将无法判断补偿性修复是否充分。问题源于修复规模的异质性。
